title: c2.doctrine.set
description: Sets doctrine at side, group or unit level (09 §11.1), e.g. values {weaponsControl:"tight", onContact:"engage", advanceOnContact:false, pauseOnFirstLaunch:true}. lock makes keys binding for lower levels. Nothing changes on error; a key locked higher up fails with reason locked_by:side|group. Needs the BDArmory binding (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE without it).

target.description: side name, group name, or unit reference; defaults to the session's side for level side

values.description: doctrine keys and values (strings, numbers, booleans)

lock.description: keys to lock at this level
